scope.summary: This Indian Standard prescribes the quality baselines, physical-chemical characteristics, and testing methods for liquids used as impregnating agents in power capacitors conforming to IS 2834 : 1986.

allied_standards.title: Openwell Submersible Pumpsets — Specification
allied_standards.relevance: Submersible pump single-phase motor circuits utilize starting/running capacitors. Winding-aligned capacitors are filled with fluids conforming to IS 13067 to withstand humidity, resist extreme heat, and prevent dielectric ground shorts.

allied_standards.title: Insulating Varnishes Containing Solvents — Specification
allied_standards.relevance: Terminal slots and connections coated in hot-curing varnishes operate completely immersed in or adjacent to the capacitor impregnating fluid, requiring high mutual chemical compatibility.

allied_standards.title: Methods of Test for Determination of Flammability of Solid Electrical Insulating Materials when Exposed to an Igniting Source: Part 2 Vertical Specimen Method
allied_standards.relevance: Capacitor terminal housings and plastic spacer materials used alongside impregnating liquids must satisfy self-extinguishing Class FV0 vertical flammability limits to prevent fire propagation.

However, under public utility and industrial power factor correction (PFC) installation guidelines, power capacitors and their raw impregnants must carry test certificates verifying compliance with IS 13067 to ensure safety and grid stability.

requirements.detail: Observed or calculated final test values, specific gravity decimals, or dissipation factors must be rounded off mathematically in accordance with IS 2:1960. The number of significant places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
Defined as the ratio of the weight in air of a given volume of the fluid at 29.5°C to the weight in air of an equal volume of water at 29.5°C.

Restricted to safe, non-toxic organic compounds, specifically covering Ester Compounds and Synthesised Hydrocarbon Compounds, while strictly excluding hazardous polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs/Askarels).

Determines the presence of acidic compounds by measuring the milligrams of KOH required to neutralize one gram of fluid. Acid limits are restricted to very low levels (typically <= 0.01 or 0.03 mg KOH/g) to prevent paper insulation breakdown.

Defined as the ratio of capacitance Cp of a given configuration of electrodes with the material as dielectric to capacitance Cv of the same electrode with air as dielectric, establishing standard dielectric spacing.
Evaluates specific insulation performance in ohm-centimeters (Ohm-cm), representing the ratio of potential gradient in volts/cm to current density in amperes/cm².
Measures the tangent of the angle (delta) by which the phase difference between applied voltage and resulting current deviates from pi/2 radian to control internal thermal dielectric losses.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 13067 : 1991 (Reaffirmed 2025) is the primary national Indian Standard specification prescribing quality requirements and testing methods for liquid impregnants used in power capacitors. Maintained under the Fluids for Electrotechnical Applications Sectional Committee (ETD 03), the standard unifies safety, thermal conduction, and electrical insulation properties for Ester and Synthesised Hydrocarbon compounds. By regulating specific gravity, flash point, low neutralization values, high resistivity, and minimal dielectric dissipation factor (tan delta), the code ensures that air and moisture are thoroughly flushed from capacitor elements, preventing localized tracking, thermal breakdown, and explosive flashovers in industrial power grids.
